title: Lucent's General Knowledge
subtitle: The one-volume reference for the static half of the GK syllabus
author: Dr. Binay Karna, Sanjiv Kumar, Manohar Pandey
recommendation: Best book for building a GK base from zero, and for revising facts before a paper.
subject: gk
description: One compact book covering Indian history, polity, geography, economy and general science in point form, which is what a first read of the GK syllabus needs.
bestFor: Aspirants building a GK base from zero, and anyone revising facts the week before a paper.
buyIf: You want one affordable book that covers the static half of the GK syllabus end to end.
avoidIf: You already maintain your own static GK notes - this adds nothing new.
howToUse: Read the sections that map to your syllabus once for coverage, then only the highlighted facts on later passes.
pros: The whole static GK syllabus in one slim volume
Point-form pages that are quick to revise the week before a paper
Cheap enough to buy beside a subject book
cons: Explanations are brief - it summarises rather than teaches
Punjab-specific coverage is thin next to a state GK book
seoTitle: Lucent's General Knowledge: Review and Prep Use
seoDescription: What Lucent's General Knowledge covers, who it suits, which chapters to read and who should skip it - plus free Punjab exam notes to study beside it.
